description: This file contains Go source code implementing integrity check commands for the Mattermost server, including functions for performing relational integrity checks and printing results, as well as command setup using Cobra.

methods.name: printRelationalIntegrityCheckResult
methods.description: Prints the results of a relational integrity check, including orphaned records and parent-child relationships.

methods.name: printIntegrityCheckResult
methods.description: Dispatches printing of integrity check results based on data type.

methods.name: integrityCmdF
methods.description: Main function executed by the integrity command, performing the check and handling user confirmation and errors.
